issue.title: Discover RSD selection tests by pattern instead of hand-kept lists
issue.body:
**What:** Each new RSD test file in the native port has to be added by hand to four lists:
- `tools/migration/lib/rsd-drawing-checks.mjs`
- `tools/migration/rsd-drawing-vitest.config.mjs`
- the exclusions in `tools/vitest.config.mjs`
- `tools/tests/tool-specifier-resolution.test.mjs`

On 2026-10-13, three parallel primitive branches (#2838, #2840 and U7) all conflicted on those same lines as soon as the first one merged. Seventeen more parity units (U8–U24) will each add tests the same way.

**Where:** the four files above, and `tools/migration/tests/`.

**Done when:**
- RSD selection tests are discovered by a naming pattern (for example `tools/migration/tests/rsd-native-*.test.mjs`), not hand-kept lists.
- The tools tier excludes that same pattern.
- The specifier-resolution check derives its set from the same source.
- A guard fails if a test matching the pattern runs in neither tier, or in both.
- Adding a new RSD test file touches only the test file.

Part of #2690.
